roadmap.title: Story first
roadmap.text: Play the five chapters in order. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house before that chapter ends — it is the list's only possibly missable trophy. Take optional missions as they appear, scan vehicles and study animals as you travel, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion Checklist
roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The thresholds are lenient — about 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and only 70 of 80 challenges, so you can skip the hardest ones. All 42 shooting-range golds, drone-race wins at all 14 locations, robberies and card sets belong here.

roadmap.title: Strangers & cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands and the character quests, then clean up the world trophies: partner moments, one-off stunts, and the five trophies whose triggers no guide had confirmed at launch.

roadmap.title: Platinum
roadmap.text: Vice Got a Price! pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Difficulty 4/10, one playthrough, no online trophies, and keep cheats off the whole run — a cheat disables trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks itself — there is no separate task behind it. Plan around the long tail: the story (five chapters, about 60–80 hours) plus the 100% checklist is where nearly all the time goes, roughly 200 hours in total at PowerPyx's 4/10 estimate. Keep cheats off the whole run: turning one on disables trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks in the opening hour with no preparation, and PowerPyx lists it as automatic and impossible to miss. Play it as the story presents it — no side work is needed first.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the first meditation spot at Jason's house — that meditation is the one possibly missable step in the whole list, and the chapter will not offer it again.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Both protagonists become playable in this chapter, which opens most of the list's side content. Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals as you travel — that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist later.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. The robbery trophies start opening up in Chapters 3 and 4, so use this stretch to attempt the shop, vault and armored-truck robberies as they appear. The chapter trophy itself unlocks automatically when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save is your only way back to a missed story moment. Finish the chapter and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Save manually before it — with no mission replay, this is the last point you can step back from. After the credits the game returns you to free-roam, where the 100% checklist and the cleanup begin.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies are automatic: play the mission when the story offers it and finish it. Nothing here needs doing outside the mission itself.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Like every mission trophy it unlocks on completion, so take it when the story presents it. This is a story heist, not a free-roam robbery — do not confuse it with the bank-vault trophy, Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Automatic on mission completion. It is a hidden story trophy, so its name and mission title are spoilers — the tracker's spoiler setting hides it until you earn it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Automatic on completion. No preparation is needed; story missions unlock in order as you play the chapters.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic on completion. VCIA is the airport — the related free-roam trophy, Catch Me If You Can, is a separate stunt there, not this mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic on completion. This is the last named mission trophy before the finale; finish it and the road to the final mission is open.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the hardest trophy in the set, and the whole platinum's long tail. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but progress made during the story already counts. The thresholds are lenient, about 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and only 70 of 80 challenges, so you can skip the hardest ones.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's jump, drift and air-time moments — chain them in free-roam driving rather than hunting a single spot. They stack across the whole playthrough, so every stunt from the story onward counts; treat it as a background counter and check it during cleanup.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game tracks 9 activity types — sample one of each rather than mastering any. Work through the activities as they unlock in free-roam; fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races and meditation all count toward the set.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. All 42 are required for this trophy and for the 100% checklist, so they cannot be skipped. Practice one range at a time and use the gold-medal thresholds as your target — the medals are not counted among the hardest challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations, with 42 races in total across them. You only need one win per location, not every race. Learn each course's line before racing it for the win, and leave the hardest race variants for last.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count per event, so winning the same race twice adds nothing — spread your wins across 20 distinct races. Mix race types as they appear in free-roam and check the race menu for ones you have not won yet.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and win the head-to-head — fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so the attempt also feeds Master of None. Watch Cal's pace and do not rush the reel; the challenge is a duel, not a timed catch count.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in free-roam and play one game through to its end. Any single completed game counts — pick the shortest one if you only want the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Character quests end with a final mission each; finish Andy's strand when it appears. These strands are story-adjacent content, so do them as they unlock rather than leaving all five for the end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's strand to its last mission. Like the other character finales it is a story-adjacent mission trophy, automatic on completion.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand to its last mission. Automatic on completion; take it when the strand offers the finale.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger strands are the game's side-quest chains — finish any 8 of them. They are mostly post-story cleanup, about 10 hours alongside the other character quests.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand to its last mission. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand to its last mission. Automatic on completion.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: The only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable. The first meditation spot is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter — and there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. This is the list's only possibly missable trophy: the first spot is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends — meditating with Lucia and Jason at one spot counts double — then work through the other spots in free-roam.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests ask you to hunt specific unique animals — follow his strand until the unique animal is marked. Studying animals through binoculars also feeds the 100% checklist, so hunt with the checklist in mind.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are a collectible set — complete any 3 full sets. Track which sets you have finished and hunt the missing cards in free-roam; only 3 sets are needed, not every card in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-and-share spot action — use it at 100 distinct locations across Leonida. It stacks across the whole game, so WAiNK at every new place you visit rather than grinding it at the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's 80 tracked feats, and only 50 are needed here — 70 for the 100% checklist. Pick the easiest 50 first and skip the hardest ones; the counter is cumulative across the playthrough.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat dies. Use fast cars and back roads; losing the cops with a partner takes longer than solo, so do not stop for a fight.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner and keep a wanted level active the whole chain — if it drops to zero, the chain resets. Plan a tight route between three nearby shops and keep the getaway car ready.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles count as discovered when you scan or enter them — 200 of 277 are needed for 100%, so this 100 is a milestone on that road. Scan every new vehicle you pass during the story and in free-roam.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-time aim mode — trigger it with 5 enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a crowded fight, not a duel, and use a weapon with a fast follow-up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get a plane moving at the airport and leave without a flight plan — an unscheduled takeoff. Expect a wanted level the moment you do it, so have an exit route planned.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks — get into one and survive the heat it draws. Approach it as a stunt: commandeer a Rhino in free-roam and stay alive in it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras spotting you. Scout the store first, then rob it clean; if you are seen, leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are one of the robbery types the 100% checklist requires in full. Hit five vaults and escape each time — plan the getaway before you go in, and treat each vault as its own attempt.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck in free-roam, stop it, take the cash and get clear. Do not linger at the scene — the escape is part of the trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named area of the state — the map fills in as you go. Mop up the corners you never visited during the story in a free-roam sweep at the end.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs illegal operations — rob one per gang. Illegal operations are part of the 100% checklist's robbery requirements, so they count twice.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description points to Ocean Beach — but no guide had a confirmed unlock method at launch. The honest read: find a bar or viewpoint on Ocean Beach and have a cocktail there; treat this as unconfirmed until a guide pins the exact spot down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description suggests driving out through a showroom's front — but no guide had a confirmed unlock method at launch. Try a vehicle showroom in free-roam and treat the exact trigger as unconfirmed until a guide pins it down.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — the follow-through is the shot itself. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also feeds Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description names no place or action, and no launch-era guide in the sources checked had pinned its trigger down. Work through the partner activities and watch for it; treat any specific claim about this one as unconfirmed until a guide verifies it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This one is a cumulative counter: PlayStation tracks it toward 500 choices. It fills in as you play the story and side content — no single choice unlocks it, so just keep making choices and check the counter during cleanup.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt — but no guide had a confirmed trigger at launch. Try a failed-then-retried activity and treat the exact trigger as unconfirmed until a guide pins it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description reads like a strange-encounter trophy. No guide had a confirmed trigger at launch — treat it as unconfirmed and watch for it while exploring the odd corners of Leonida.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A melee drive-by that knocks someone down — the description is the whole clue, and no guide had a confirmed trigger at launch. Try it from a slow-moving vehicle with a melee weapon and treat the exact trigger as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It stacks across the game, so launder after every big robbery rather than saving it up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spending is cumulative across every shop in the game. Buy gear, clothes and ammo as you play — the counter fills itself, and big purchases late in the game finish it off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market. Garages hold the vehicles you discover, so buy them as you expand the collection.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register 10 vehicles you have discovered. Any 10 count — register the ones you already own first.
